No! There's no point thinking about it right
now! I'm better off thinking of something else!
<CLT=cltMIND>Should I hang out with Kaito for a while?

There's a theory that the moon was created 
when a giant meteorite smashed into the Earth!

<CLT=cltMIND>I spent some time with Kaito
discussing the mysteries of space...
<CLT=cltMIND>Kaito and I grew a little closer today.
